name: Pumble
one_liner: Team messaging app Pumble, with an API addon for messages, channels and reactions, plus an MCP server.
auth_notes: Install the API addon in the workspace, then generate an API key from the API section of the sidebar. The MCP server uses an app key, user token and bot token created in Workspace settings.
access_notes: Requires installing the API addon in the Pumble workspace and then generating a key in the API sidebar section. Pricing and any plan requirement are not stated in the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key and documented HTTP API with a rate limit, but the action set is narrow: messages, replies, reactions, channels and message listing. Pricing is not stated in the fetched pages.

auth.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.

access.quote: Before you can create an API key, you need to install the API addon on your Pumble workspace.

api_surface.quote: The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation.

mcp.quote: Pumble's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables you to connect your AI agent of choice

needs_human_reason: Pricing and plan requirements, sandbox availability, pagination and webhook support, the Swagger/OpenAPI URL and the MCP endpoint URL are not in the fetched pages. The API style is recorded as other because the pages say HTTP requests and Swagger, not REST.
